style: Premium commercial product photo for portrait digital menu board. Pure white seamless background #FFFFFF, soft natural contact shadow, centered hero product filling 70-85% of frame, 35-degree camera angle, crisp studio lighting, side-back light for liquid glow, ultra realistic, appetizing, no text, no logo, no watermark, no hands, minimal tasteful garnish props only where noted. MANDATORY for drinks: clear disposable plastic takeaway coffee-shop cup, NO lid, NO dome lid, NO straw hole cover, open top with drink surface foam fully visible. ICE RULE: ice cubes only for drinks actually served iced (iced latte, espresso tonic, bumble, iced mocha, lemonade, milkshake, frappuccino, coconut caramel iced latte, fresh juice). All other drinks: NO ice, hot drinks show steam.
